text:
ashley_sales: Heads-up — AcmeRetail wants a perf run for the POC next week. They care about microbursts (10s–30s), sustained 250 qps, and p95 < 200ms for customer-facing completions. Need a load plan, infra advise, and a quick cost delta for hosted vs. dedicated. Can we sketch?
kevin_se: Got it. Do we have their average prompt+response token sizes and model family? That changes batching and qps calculations.
lina_perf: They said ~60 tokens prompt, ~150 tokens response on avg. Model: open-llama-70b-ish quantized variant. Workload is mix: 70% short chat, 30% long completions.
kevin_se: Perfect. For planning: propose 3 phases — warmup (5m at 30% load), sustained run (30m at 250 qps), microburst sweeps (5x bursts: 600 qps for 20s, 1m apart). Add cooldown.
ashley_sales: Can you also include prewarm strategy? They worry about cold-start tail.
lina_perf: Prewarm plan: 1) prefix cache preload with 1k representative requests; 2) keep a small reserve of reserved pods for Dedicated (10% extra capacity) or 2x concurrency slot warm workers on Hosted.
kevin_se: Example load generator command we'll use (wrk2 + custom script):
```
wrk -t16 -c400 -d30s -R600 --script=chat_mix.lua --latency $TARGET_HOST
```
Include tokens-per-second tracking via our trace tag.
jamie_ops: For infra sizing — if they run on Dedicated with A100-equivalent: 250 sustained qps @ 70b-quant roughly needs ~6 GPUs with continuous batching and KV cache, 8 GPUs for microbursts headroom. For Hosted estimate: autoscale to same peak but higher unit cost (~1.6-2x).
kevin_se: Note: enabling dynamic KV caching reduces effective compute by ~25% for chat-style reuse; we'll measure with/without to show cost delta.
sophie_sec: Security questions they flagged: KMS for embeddings and logs, SSO via SAML, and enterprise audit logs retention 90d. Also want confirmation data-in-transit and at-rest encryption.
ashley_sales: They also asked about network egress and multi-AZ failover — can we show latency impact of cross-AZ fallback?
lina_perf: Add a two-region fallback trial: run sustained in region A, force 10% of traffic to fallback region B for 10m window and capture p95/p99 delta. Expect +30–80ms added depending on region pair.
kevin_se: For measurement we'll capture: p50/p95/p99, token/sec, GPU utilization, batch size distribution, and queue length. We'll attach sampling traces for 1% of requests.
ashley_sales: Pricing ask: can you rough a monthly cost comparison for their 1M req/mo baseline (avg tokens per req 210)? Just a ballpark for sales to share.
amie_ops: (typo)
jamie_ops: Quick ballpark: Hosted: ~$3.8k/mo for inference units + burst fees (highly dependent on token pricing). Dedicated reserved (monthly commit): ~$2.5k–3k/mo in reserved capacity amortized + infra ops. We'll prepare a cleaner table after the run.
kevin_se: We'll include a runbook for the customer-facing team: steps to reproduce, toggles (quant bits, batch size), and regression checklist.
ashley_sales: Timeline? Acme wants results by Tue next week. Can we run today/tomorrow internal dry-run and Friday run with them?
lina_perf: I can run internal dry-run tomorrow morning 09:00 PT. Need access to sample prompt set and API key with identical model variant.
sophie_sec: For POC with their prod data, they require our Private offering or strict EP agreement. For demo data it's fine on Hosted. Need security sign-off if we touch real data.
kevin_se: Action items: 1) ashley upload sample prompt corpus (50k) — due EOD today. 2) jamie provision test cluster for dry-run — due tomorrow 08:00 PT. 3) lina run dry-run and post raw results. 4) sophie confirm KMS/SAML checklist and share required contract clause.
ashley_sales: I'm on it — uploading corpus now (link: https://redwood-internal/pocts/acmeretail/corpus).
jamie_ops: Provisioned test cluster: 8 x A10g equiv, network in us-west2, logs hooked to ephemeral bucket. Credentials posted to secure vault.
deploy-bot: CI job #4421 completed: loadgen image build OK.
lina_perf: Dry-run summary (quick): warmup stable, sustained 250 qps p95=190ms, p99=410ms. Microburst 600 qps 20s shows p95 spike to 480ms, p99 to 1.2s. GPU util avg 82% during sustained, 98% during bursts. Full logs -> secure link.
kevin_se: Those numbers look promising. Add one more sweep with KV-cache disabled to quantify delta.
sophie_sec: Reminder: before customer-run with their data we need signed DPA + KMS key exchange and SSO test account.
ashley_sales: I'll push DPA and get SSO details. Customer run tentatively scheduled Friday 10:00 PT.
lina_perf: I'll prep a short slide with charts (p95/p99 over time, GPU util, batch size heatmap) and a short cost appendix (hosted vs dedicated).
kevin_se: Also include recommended runtime config: batch_target=1024ms, max_batch_tokens=32k, kv_cache_enabled=true, quant=8-bit for Dedicated.
jamie_ops: Noted — will keep 2x headroom for bursts and enable autoscale cooldown of 60s to avoid thrash.
ashley_sales: Thanks all. I'll update Acme and book Friday slot. :thumbsup:
kevin_se: small follow-up: if they accept Dedicated, we can offer a 3-month trial discount and free KMS setup to accelerate security sign-off.
ashley_sales: Nice. I'll mention that in the contract convo.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window Sat 02:00–04:00 PT — no runs should be scheduled then.
